steelTriggerFixture.interpretation: The controlled source fixture triggers Mole excavation with a steel-tagged object. The decoded tag combines the runtime's solid bit 0x20 and steel bit 0x40. This establishes the material in this witness, but not whether other materials also trigger Mole excavation.

runtimeGap.observedRuntimeBehavior: The Mole patrol checks only the 0x20 solid bit through isSolid(_:_:). It changes horizontal position and direction. It does not inspect the 0x40 steel bit, update vertical position, or add terrain edits.
runtimeGap.fixtureBehavior: The retained source fixture places left-facing Mole object 10013 at (152,92) and steel cells with tag 0x60 at x=112...119, y=96...111. The source trace reports steel contact and first down-right motion at tick 36.
runtimeGap.interpretation: The production code lacks the observed steel-triggered excavation path and source vertical movement. This identifies missing behaviour, but the source tunnel-edge witnesses still do not establish the exact excavation mask.
